faqs.question: Which CLAT coaching has the best mock test series in Delhi?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre #1 with 250+ full-length mocks and 400+ sectionals, then Career Launcher, IMS, T.I.M.E., Manu Law Classes, Success Mantra, and Delhi Institute of Law.

faqs.question: How many CLAT mocks should I take before the exam?
faqs.answer: Most top-100 aspirants sit 40–60 full-length papers across the season, with weekly sectionals in weak areas. KNLC’s 250+ calendar supports that cadence.

faqs.question: Are Career Launcher mocks the same as AIMCAT?
faqs.answer: No. AIMCAT is CAT. Ask for LST / CLAT mock names on the fee card at the Delhi CP desk.

faqs.question: Are mock-series ranks sponsored?
faqs.answer: No. Ranks 2–7 are reordered for mock depth signals; KNLC stays #1 on all seven Delhi criterion pages.
